content: Apple AVPlayerLayer.videoRect gives image position and size within bounds and accounts for media aspect and gravity; preview conversion methods connect unrotated top-left capture-device coordinates and layer points. Project inference: convert bottom-left oriented analysis coordinates explicitly before preview conversion, and map playback points through actual videoRect rather than whole SwiftUI container. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avplayerlayer/videorect https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avcapturevideopreviewlayer/capturedevicepointconverted(fromlayerpoint:) .
